title: What If Mosquitoes Went Extinct Tomorrow?

scenes.text: What if mosquitoes vanished tomorrow? The scientists' answer might surprise you.
There are about 3,500 species. Only around 200 bite humans.
Three groups spread diseases that kill roughly 700,000 people a year.
The pain would be in the Arctic. Some estimates say tundra bird numbers could fall by about half.
Spiders, frogs and fish that eat larvae would lose a big meal, but most would switch prey.
Most scientists think nature would adapt. One said the main effect would be more people.

description:
What if mosquitoes went extinct tomorrow?
About 3,500 species exist, only around 200 bite us, and most scientists think ecosystems would adapt.
